rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is true only on the surface or appears so publicly.

example.english: They ostensibly said they supported me, but kept opposing me behind my back.
example.traditional: 佢表面上話支持我，但係背後不斷唱反調。
example.jyutping: keoi5 biu2 min6 soeng6 waa6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 daan6 hai6 bui3 hau6 bat1 dyun6 coeng3 faan2 diu6

rows.note: Use this for the slice meaning that something seems or appears a certain way from the available evidence.

example.english: This shop ostensibly looks quite clean, but you only know once you go in.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭睇落幾乾淨，入去先知。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 tai2 lok6 gei2 gon1 zeng6 jap6 heoi3 sin1 zi1

rows.note: Use this when repeating someone’s claim while signaling that you are doubtful about it.

example.english: They ostensibly claim not to be afraid of the cold, but put on their coats as soon as they go outside.
example.traditional: 佢哋話就話唔怕凍，但係一出街就著晒件褸。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 waa6 zau6 waa6 m4 paa3 dung3 daan6 hai6 jat1 ceot1 gaai1 zau6 zoek6 saai3 gin6 lau1
